chunks: “There are twelve qualities in the siwak: it is from the sunnah (prophetic tradition), a purifier for the mouth, a polish for the sight, it pleases the All-Merciful, whitens the teeth, removes decay, strengthens the gums, stimulates appetite, removes phlegm, increases memory, multiplies good deeds, and the angels rejoice because of it.”

key_terms.السُّنَّةِ: the established prophetic tradition and recommended practice
key_terms.السِّوَاكِ: tooth-cleaning stick; the practice of cleaning the teeth with siwak
key_terms.الْحَفْرِ: decay or damage affecting the teeth
key_terms.مَطْهَرَةٌ: a means of purification and cleansing

ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of using the siwak according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describes the siwak as a practice of the sunnah (prophetic tradition) that combines physical cleanliness with spiritual reward. The hadith highlights its practical health benefits and its devotional significance before Allah, the Exalted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.126 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Siwak (tooth cleaning) has twelve benefits: it is part of the Sunnah (tradition), purifies the mouth, improves vision, pleases the Merciful, whitens the teeth, removes decay, strengthens the gums, increases appetite, removes phlegm, enhances memory, multiplies good deeds, and brings joy to the angels."
